scope: Bounded, read-only audit of RIFF BOXEDVALUEREF and EBXX boxed metadata for exhaustive BF6 1.4.3.0 audit.

sharedDecoder.observed: BOXEDVALUEREF skips 8 bytes and returns a marker; EBXX array rows are parsed, boxed rows are not.

ledger.finding: captures hold raw_path/raw_sha256 and descriptor_path/descriptor_sha256; objects.body_json records markers; no XML path is recorded.

representativeAssets.classification: non-null scalar Float32; zero is a valid value

representativeAssets.decodedPayloads: Descriptor class 15 and class 16 structures; see docs/working/FROSTY_AUDIT_BOXED_REVIEW.md.

boundedSample.selection: First 100 alphabetically ordered Common/Hardware/Weapons captures with at least one boxed marker in objects.body_json.
boundedSample.interpretation: ArrayType behavior below is derived from the local SDK source, not validated against a sampled weapon asset.
boundedSample.xmlComparison: No XML export was available from the inspected datamining tree or ledger fields.

recommendedBehavior.null: Return null for zero field type or absent EBXX offset match, matching SDK default semantics.
recommendedBehavior.scalarOrStruct: Resolve category 0 using EBXX subtype and classRef and retain those metadata with the decoded value.
recommendedBehavior.array: For category 4, follow the relative array header and embedded count. Decode descriptor-backed elements only when ClassRef identifies an array descriptor. With ClassRef 65535, the SDK records subtype but leaves value unset; preserve array metadata/header without claiming scalar elements were decoded.
recommendedBehavior.nativeSemantics: Unknown; this audit establishes serialized representation only.

proposedChecks: Zero reference type word yields null.
Nonzero reference with no EBXX row remains a distinct null/default outcome.
DesertTech HTI boxed structs resolve with classRef 15 and classRef 16.
Exercise masked and unmasked reference type words.
Use an array fixture with descriptor-backed struct elements and check the ClassRef 65535 metadata-only path; no asset-backed array case was found in the bounded sample.
